name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.income.view.IncomeActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page from the account area as an earnings dashboard. It loads the account's earnings summary and records, supports refresh and pagination, and links to income details and withdrawal actions.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's earnings and withdrawal entry page.
